authorization: User explicitly approved OFFLINE design of a minimal platform-identification plan. This is NOT consent to new excitation, motion, flashing or a new reference trajectory.
purpose: Obtain informative and time-aligned input/output data before further controller screening. Identify a task-local command-count-to-motor-encoder model and its uncertainty; not claim calibrated force, mass, carriage kinematics or global plant identification.

literatureBasis.use: Separate one-step equation error from recursive simulation error; check excitation/data-matrix singular values.
Closed-loop data informativity motivates independent designed excitation, but no consistency theorem is claimed for the gated nonlinear experiment.

failureAndBudgetRule: Stop at any guard/data-integrity failure. Preserve it. Do not automatically repeat until successful or increase excitation. Three is an initial maximum planned diagnostic batch, NOT a guarantee of identification success. If inadequate, report the gap and review before additional captures. No formal15-run batch here.

excitationDesign.axisInjection: [common+sync,-common+sync] before final amplitude clip/quantization and ONE original speed guard; maximum nominal addition30counts/axis. Not amperes or certified safe torque.
excitationDesign.temporalScope: phase2 and4 only; no excitation in boot, initial hold, top hold, terminal hold, done or fault. Return-leg nominal sequence is negated outgoing sequence for zero nominal20s net bias.
excitationDesign.sequence: Fixed31-state maximal5bit LFSR plus balancing final symbol; no seed/amplitude selection by controller metrics. Validation changes both seed and symbol periods.
excitationDesign.feedbackGating: Zero BOTH excitation components if either rawRPM magnitude exceeds10 or any health/drive permission check fails. Continue unmodified original taper/braking/fault logic. Gating depends on feedback, so actual excitation is not assumed independent of noise or perfectly balanced.
excitationDesign.appliedIncrement: Save a same-state zero-excitation guarded-command shadow and actual attempted command in high-rate windows. Their difference is a command-level observation, not delivered torque.
excitationDesign.antiWindup: Core keeps its original internal clip residual. Ordinary outer residual for e!=0 must exclude the KNOWN requested injection: finalCommand-originalCoreCurrent-requestedInjection. Thus total residual equals finalCommand-originalCoreRequest-requestedInjection. The e==0 path must retain original exact arithmetic. This diagnostic change must be reviewed and tested, not silently added to ordinary formal data.

measurementDesign.slowFields: Every20actual controller samples: last observed board-ms timestamp,encoder offsets,both attempted-command sums and min/max,both feedback-current-count sums,endpoint rawRPM,actual elapsed-us sum,step count,feedback freshness/quality flags and maximum ages. Capacity permits2percent extra samples; overflow/partial terminal interval must be flagged and exported, never relabelled complete. Means are not exact reconstruction of every1ms signal.
measurementDesign.fastFields: Observed board-ms timestamp AND actual elapsed microseconds,raw encoder offsets,rawRPM,attempted command,feedback-current counts,same-state zero-injection guarded shadow,feedback ages,phase and quality/drive/excitation flags. Window selection uses controller sample index; do not call nominal1ms spacing exact actual timing.
measurementDesign.wholeRunContext: Keep original107channel/40ms live telemetry,voltage,temperature,faults,timing and original fault history. Encoder offsets require saved raw origins and configured sign/scale. Record source/code/config hashes and initialization.
measurementDesign.feedbackFreshness: Do not treat duplicated CAN observations as new sensor samples. Record fresh flags/age; retain actual collection timing. No interpolation of gaps into fake1ms inputs.
measurementDesign.neuralStateBoundary: This recorder replaces the event/network replay buffers in an independent diagnostic version. It is NOT a full neural-state snapshot and cannot reproduce every internal BLNN update.

memoryPlan.reuse: Replace existing24624-byte event_trace and39576-byte replay_trace; never allocate new recorder in addition to them. Remove only their diagnostic integration; preserve original1300-byte fault_trace and guards.
memoryPlan.sourceOfBudget: Verified67712ARM map; later ordinary identification target must be independently linked and checked, not assumed identical.

exportPlan.preferred: After stop and fault-history priority, explicit fresh-session read-only export request; bounded DMA binary blocks with length/index/CRC plus whole-blobCRC32. Receiver requests missing/corrupt blocks, validates two byte-identical full copies and all source identities; no start/reset/parameter operations in exporter.
exportPlan.legacyFallback: Existing107-float16-byte payload chunks with duplicate copies, unchanged40ms baud budget; slower but known transport. No hidden baud change or simultaneous VOFA/host ownership ofCOM4.

identificationMethod.fitSet: T1 only; Q0 checks consistency and provides held-out nominal context, not opportunistic tuning.
modelsPredefined: Stable first-order two-axis localARX with exogenous seed as a possible instrument; explicit closed-loop noise caveats.

Structured command-count-to-encoder grey-box model with unknown effective input gains,viscous/Coulomb or stick-slip terms,coupling and actuation delay. Use only if data rank and training evidence support identifiable lumped parameters.
identificationMethod.selection: Training-only residual and recursive-fit diagnostics, fixed bounded parameterization. Freeze model selection/parameters/code hash beforeV1. No validation-driven parameter retune within this batch.
identificationMethod.notSeparatelyIdentifiable: Without independent torque/current calibration, input gain and mass/inertia cannot be claimed separately identified. Without independent carriage displacement measurement, motor-encoder agreement does not validate transmission rigidity or absolute carriage position.
identificationMethod.checks: Input modal excitation rank/singular values using actual gated attempted commands,feedback timing/current consistency,whole-leg and whole-window recursive position/synchronization prediction,one-step error separately,residual-input dependence,parameter uncertainty and validation-domain coverage.
identificationMethod.validationThreshold: No fabricated positioning tolerance. Before physical validation freeze a model-resolution budget tied to the minimum synchronization difference the study intends to resolve. If prediction uncertainty is not below that difference, do not use model simulation to adjudicate small performance gains.
identificationMethod.caseFailures: Preserve guard failures and model failures; never compute a favourable primary mean by omitting failed cases.
identificationMethod.extrapolationForbidden: No conclusions about added2kg,10mm stroke,hard amplitude saturation,high-speed braking or new current levels from this unloaded2mm diagnostic alone.

offlinePrototypeBoundary: Host-only sequence,guard-envelope,recorderABI/aggregate/bounds andCRC tests. No linked MCU image or Keil project and no USB/serial/DAP access. These do not prove mechanical safety,MCU timing,identifiability or efficacy.
nextStep: If user later requests implementation, prepare an independentQ0 zero-excitation diagnostic version first; exact disabled-command/control regression, Keil/map/timing checks and fresh drive-OFF before flashing. A successfulQ0 does NOT authorizeT1/V1: excitation/field safety must be separately confirmed.
